title: The Pacific Brass Band and its Algiers members
summary: Love names the Pacific band's leader Joe Lazard and its cornet, trombone, baritone and drum players from Algiers.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: We're talking about the brass bands that played. Oh yeah. This guy Lazard you said had a band.
